subject.title: Preserve aborted sessions across restart opt-in

question: Should OpenClaw accept `session.restartContinuation` as a new session config contract for preserving aborted main-session ids across controlled Gateway restarts?
rationale: The implementation is plausible, but adding a new session config knob and changing persisted session-id reuse semantics is a product and upgrade-compatibility decision under the repository policy.

options.title: Pause Until Sponsored
options.body: Do not merge this PR until a maintainer explicitly accepts the new config contract and the branch is rebased against current main's done-row reuse behavior.

options.title: Sponsor The Opt-In
options.body: Keep the PR on the merge path after updating stale tests if maintainers want a narrow default-off escape hatch for this restart-continuity case.

options.title: Redirect To Config-Free Recovery
options.body: Close or supersede this branch in favor of the broader current-main restart recovery design without adding another session config option.

recommendation.title: Pause Until Sponsored
recommendation.body: Do not merge this PR until a maintainer explicitly accepts the new config contract and the branch is rebased against current main's done-row reuse behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the terminal-main transcript reconciliation behavior this PR modifies and are the strongest routing signal for the affected lifecycle invariant.
